name: my-runbox
description: Reusable Bash tooling for the scripting practicals: web access log analysis and Markdown to PDF.

scripts.report: sh -c '"./utils/sqli_incident_analysis.sh" -q || [ $? -eq 2 ] || exit 1; latest=$(ls -t reports/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n "$latest" ] || { echo "no report found in reports/" >&2; exit 1; }; exec "./utils/md2pdf.sh" "$latest"'
scripts.pdf:latest: sh -c 'latest=$(ls -t reports/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n "$latest" ] || { echo "no markdown report in reports/" >&2; exit 1; }; exec "./utils/md2pdf.sh" "$latest"'
scripts.pdf:all: sh -c 'rc=0; for f in reports/*.md; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; "./utils/md2pdf.sh" "$f" || rc=1; done; exit $rc'
scripts.lint: sh -c 'bash -n utils/sqli_incident_analysis.sh && bash -n utils/md2pdf.sh && echo "syntax OK: both tools"'
scripts.smoke: sh -c 'set -u; d=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1; trap "rm -rf \"$d\"" EXIT; "./utils/sqli_incident_analysis.sh" -q -o "$d" || [ $? -eq 2 ] || exit 1; "./utils/md2pdf.sh" README.md -o "$d/readme.pdf" || exit 1; head -c 5 "$d/readme.pdf" | grep -q "%PDF-" || exit 1; echo "smoke OK: analyser + converter"'
